label: Ren'Py: run game
args: 'f="$1"; p=$(printf %s "$f" | sed "s|\(.*\)/game/.*|\1|"); rel="game/$(printf %s "$f" | sed "s|.*/game/||")"; if [ "$p" = "$f" ]; then echo "$f is not inside a game/ folder" >&2; exit 1; fi; s="$RENPY_SDK"; if [ -z "$s" ]; then s=$(find "$HOME" "$HOME/Documents" "$HOME/Downloads" "$HOME/Desktop" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name "renpy-*-sdk" 2>/dev/null | awk -F/ "{print \$NF \"\t\" \$0}" | sort -V | tail -n 1 | cut -f 2); fi; if [ ! -f "$s/renpy.sh" ]; then echo "No Ren-Py SDK found: set RENPY_SDK to the SDK folder" >&2; exit 1; fi; exec "$s/renpy.sh" "$p" run'
